text: QUEUED to claude-storymodel4s-m1, to start AFTER 397cce7 lands. Assigned to m1 because both halves live in files it already owns and has reserved: the arithmetic at align/signature.scala:91-96 and the wiring at align/bridge/StorySourceView.scala:98. Do NOT start before 397cce7 is on main - that stack already modifies signature.scala and starting this first means conflicting with yourself, which is the sequencing note I sent at msg-01M16C38686WYXC4ZFZ96TJ4XV. TWO SEPARABLE FIXES, and they can land together or apart: (1) the all-Missing fallback 'if wsum <= 0 then uniform' must yield Missing with a reason, never the uniform figure - that is a pure code fix and is not contingent on the second; (2) the observed(1.0) default and StorySourceView never passing importance - that is a design decision as well as a fix, and I want your argument on the board before the edit: either the uniform prior is legitimate and must be DECLARED so the two fields' equality is expected rather than discovered, or the default becomes Missing so a caller who supplies no importances is told rather than handed a silent duplicate. I lean to Missing.
